synonyms = {
    "implemented": "enacted",
    "reduce": "minimize",

text = "What policies should be [implemented] for payday loans to [reduce] consumer harm while complying with the law?"

def replace_bracketed(text, mapping):

        return mapping.get(word, word)  # leave unchanged if not found
    return re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", repl, text)
